How the grades are reckoned. Coin grades your treasury, generosity and betting; Glory your fame and win rate; Honor your personality minus every poach and broken contract; Spectacle your showmanship and fame; Training your discipline and how many fighters you have improved; Arena time how crowded your stable is. Home depends on each fighter's city.

Morale is how a fighter feels this week, and it walks out onto the sand with them: 80+ high spirits (+1 AP, +1 CF when the bout begins, fights bolder) · 35-79 steady · under 35 low (−1 AP, fights cautiously) · under 20 broken (also fights a whole tier worse). It rises with bouts, fair wages, meals, kin tickets and bonuses, and falls with idle weeks, low pay and a greedy lanista. Very low morale also invites early retirement and poachers. Loyalty is their bond to your ludus (from your Honor, their morale, minus your Greed, plus the bonds you build). It is the number a rival must beat to poach them, it decides who stays when the legions call, and it keeps contracts renewing.
